body:
## Code Review

This pull request adds generated VLM bulk crop proposal outputs, receipts, readbacks, and validator results for waves 002 through 008. Feedback was provided regarding the sorting of JSON arrays in the generated artifacts, which should be sorted lexicographically to prevent diff churn and maintain consistency.
